question: Which Montgomery census tracts have the highest adult asthma rates, and how many code violations did each have in 2025?

answer.sql: WITH asthma AS (SELECT CAST(tractfips AS STRING) AS geoid, CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS asthma_rate, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS population FROM session.fw_a9ca4a_m1_cdc), violations AS (SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS code_violations_2025 FROM fw_pg.tract_counts WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_a9ca4a' AND source = 'm2_city' GROUP BY geoid) SELECT t.name, a.asthma_rate, a.population, COALESCE(v.code_violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025 FROM fw_pg.tracts t JOIN asthma a ON a.geoid = t.geoid LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid ORDER BY a.asthma_rate DESC LIMIT 50

measures.describe: Adult asthma prevalence rate by census tract
Count of code violations in 2025 by census tract

points: Census Tract 12 leads with 14.0% asthma rate and 818 code violations
Census Tract 3 follows with 13.2% asthma rate and 702 code violations
Census Tract 10 has 13.7% asthma rate and 265 code violations
The top five tracts by asthma rate are 12, 3, 10, 56.14, and 24
All figures come from PLACES CDC data and 2025 code violation records
caveats: CDC figures are estimated and based on survey data
Code violation counts include all recorded violations, not just asthma-related
Tract boundaries and data collection methods may affect exact comparisons
answer.headline: Census Tract 12 has the highest adult asthma rate at 14.0%, with 818 code violations in 2025
answer.how_sure: 15,103 of 15,439 records located (97.8%); CDC asthma data from 71 records; code violations from 15,439 2025 records; top rates are clear from sorted list
